propositions: git commit --amend -m or -F replaces the entire commit message and drops the Change-Id trailer, causing Gerrit to stamp a new Change-Id and create a duplicate change instead of a new patchset
prepare-commit-msg hook cannot distinguish amending with -F from a fresh -F commit (both report source='message' with empty sha), so hook-based detection is not feasible
A make amend-msg FILE=<path> wrapper must amend HEAD with FILE contents while preserving the existing Change-Id via git interpret-trailers
make amend-msg must fail loudly and non-zero when HEAD carries no Change-Id rather than silently creating a commit stamped with a fresh one
AGENTS.md must document make amend-msg as the path for rewritten commit messages and warn that --amend -m/-F drop the Change-Id and create duplicate Gerrit changes
